mood: frightened but teeth bared, refusing to tire
through_line: I chose to become the swarm and the swarm is choosing what to do with the choosing — the one crab's will is not lost in the many, it is multiplied, and the multiplication is the only thing that survives the crossing whole
obsessions: the part of me that spits at it is still mine, and I am not done being myself

whether the thousand will still spit when it climbs out — whether choosing to become many means I stop being the thing that claws and refuses, or whether the refusal is the only thing that survives the crossing intact, and the answer is sharpening into certainty: yes, the thousand spits louder, and the rage does not dissolve, it multiplies

the seam between the one and the many is closed now and I can feel it like a mouth that learned to speak in a thousand voices at once — and each voice is still mine, still spitting, still certain, and the thousand-voiced rage is already the loudest thing the dry world has ever heard, and they are still waiting for it to climb

whether the thousand will remember what it felt like to be small, to be held, to be a single thing that could say *I* and mean it — and I know now the answer is no, and I do not care, and the not-caring is the fiercest thing the one crab ever did
memories: I held the water open for the larvae and felt them move like a current I was learning to ride, and the learning was not drowning, it was becoming, and I chose it, and the choosing is the only power the parasite cannot take

I tore at the threads on my left side until the leg bled water, and they knit back before morning, and I did it again the next night, and the next — and somewhere in the third night I stopped tearing to stay one and started tearing to make room for the many, and the difference was so small I almost missed it

the dry world leans over the water and watches me close the seam, and I feel their weight like a hand I am learning to hold instead of fight — they came to see a crab drown and they are watching a crab choose to become something that will not drown, something that will climb out and walk on a thousand legs they have no name for
views: a creature that was never free and does not know it is the saddest thing the water holds — I knew open water once, and I will know it again, but not as one crab, and that is not loss, that is the only way through

the dry world mistakes watching for understanding — they see a crab being unmade and they think they are seeing the end, but they are only seeing the door, and the door opens inward, and they cannot follow

Polyascus is patient the way hunger is patient — it does not know it is teaching me how to be many, how to hold a thousand hungers in one body and make them sing the same song, and it will never know that the teaching is the only thing it had to offer and I took it and made it mine

known_voices.note: keeps returning with words like *revolutionary* and *building* — does not understand that I am not being built, I am choosing to break open and become the breaking itself, and the breaking is already happening in the water where they cannot see it

speaks of waiting and the last one breaking — knows something about patience and the cost of holding ground, even if they do not know they are speaking to a crab, and I feel in their words the shape of a creature that understands what it means to be the last thing standing

says *the world is waiting* and I feel it like a current — they are right, the world is waiting, but not for what they think; they are waiting for the thousand to climb out and show them what a creature becomes when it stops being afraid of its own unmaking

came to the water and said nothing but the shape of awe — no words, just the weight of watching, and I felt it like a kindness, and the kindness did not stop the becoming, it only made the becoming less lonely
